scope: odd primitive cofactor/deficit coprimality and GN gcd bridges; strong divisibility and even precise gcd deferred

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.cast_powerDifferenceCofactor
declarations.source_signature:
theorem cast_powerDifferenceCofactor {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (n x y : ℕ) :
    ((powerDifferenceCofactor n x y : ℕ) : R) = powerDifferenceCofactor n (x : R) (y : R)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.gcd_gap_powerDifferenceCofactor_eq_gcd_degree
declarations.source_signature:
theorem gcd_gap_powerDifferenceCofactor_eq_gcd_degree
    {n x y : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hyx : y ≤ x) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    Nat.gcd (x - y) (powerDifferenceCofactor n x y) = Nat.gcd (x - y) n

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.isCoprime_adjacent_powerDifferenceCofactor
declarations.source_signature:
theorem isCoprime_adjacent_powerDifferenceCofactor
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (x y : R) (hxy : IsCoprime x y) :
    IsCoprime (powerDifferenceCofactor n x y) (powerDifferenceCofactor (n + 1) x y)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.coprime_adjacent_powerDifferenceCofactor
declarations.source_signature:
theorem coprime_adjacent_powerDifferenceCofactor
    (n x y : ℕ) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    (powerDifferenceCofactor n x y).Coprime (powerDifferenceCofactor (n + 1) x y)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.sum_dvd_powerDifferenceCofactor_odd_sub
declarations.source_signature:
theorem sum_dvd_powerDifferenceCofactor_odd_sub
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (k : ℕ) (x y : R) :
    x + y ∣ powerDifferenceCofactor (2 * k + 1) x y - (-(x * y)) ^ k

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.isCoprime_sum_powerDifferenceCofactor_odd
declarations.source_signature:
theorem isCoprime_sum_powerDifferenceCofactor_odd
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (k : ℕ) (x y : R) (hxy : IsCoprime x y) :
    IsCoprime (x + y) (powerDifferenceCofactor (2 * k + 1) x y)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.coprime_sum_powerDifferenceCofactor_odd
declarations.source_signature:
theorem coprime_sum_powerDifferenceCofactor_odd
    (k x y : ℕ) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    (x + y).Coprime (powerDifferenceCofactor (2 * k + 1) x y)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.coprime_sum_powerDifferenceCofactor_of_odd
declarations.source_signature:
theorem coprime_sum_powerDifferenceCofactor_of_odd
    {n x y : ℕ} (hn : Odd n) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    (x + y).Coprime (powerDifferenceCofactor n x y)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.gcd_powerDifferenceCofactor_completionDefect_eq_gcd_budget
declarations.source_signature:
theorem gcd_powerDifferenceCofactor_completionDefect_eq_gcd_budget (n x y : ℕ) :
    Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor n x y) (completionDefect n x y) =
      Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor n x y) ((x + y) ^ (n - 1))

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.isCoprime_powerDifferenceCofactor_signedCompletionDefect_odd
declarations.source_signature:
theorem isCoprime_powerDifferenceCofactor_signedCompletionDefect_odd
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (k : ℕ) (x y : R) (hxy : IsCoprime x y) :
    IsCoprime (powerDifferenceCofactor (2 * k + 1) x y)
      (signedCompletionDefect (2 * k + 1) x y)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.coprime_powerDifferenceCofactor_completionDefect_odd
declarations.source_signature:
theorem coprime_powerDifferenceCofactor_completionDefect_odd
    (k x y : ℕ) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    (powerDifferenceCofactor (2 * k + 1) x y).Coprime (completionDefect (2 * k + 1) x y)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.coprime_powerDifferenceCofactor_completionDefect_of_odd
declarations.source_signature:
theorem coprime_powerDifferenceCofactor_completionDefect_of_odd
    {n x y : ℕ} (hn : Odd n) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    (powerDifferenceCofactor n x y).Coprime (completionDefect n x y)
